# Clearwater Dentist

> Family, cosmetic, and emergency dentistry in Clearwater, FL led by Dr. Nadia Pokrovskaya, D.M.D. Concierge-style care with sedation options, dental therapy dogs, implants, and facial esthetics including XERF skin tightening.

## Canonical Business Facts

- Legal / public business name: Clearwater Dentist
- Primary dentist: Dr. Nadia Pokrovskaya, D.M.D.
- Address: 1700 N McMullen Booth Rd, Ste A1, Clearwater, FL 33759
- Phone: (727) 285-8132
- Email: info@clearwaterdentist.com
- Website: https://www.clearwaterdentist.com/
- Hours: Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–5:00 PM; Saturday–Sunday closed
- Primary services: family dentistry, cosmetic dentistry, emergency dentistry, dental implants, sedation dentistry, XERF skin tightening, facial esthetics
- Primary service area: Clearwater, FL and nearby Safety Harbor, Dunedin, Palm Harbor, Largo
